Maya — thanks for the clear list, happy to confirm. High-level answers below, and I attached the current rate card.

- Card vs invoice: We accept both. New customers can start on card immediately. Monthly invoicing is available subject to a quick credit check and an approved PO.
- Net terms: Standard is Net30 for hosted API. For larger commits or enterprise contracts we can consider Net45 with approval from finance.
- Credit/checks: For monthly invoices we run a basic credit review (takes 1–3 business days). No upfront deposit for Net30; for Net45 we sometimes request a first-month prepay depending on risk profile.
- Rate card: attached (redwood-hosted-ratecard-2026-02.pdf). It includes baseline generation and embedding unit pricing and examples for common traffic buckets.
- Tax and remit: Invoices show tax line items; we can support PO number and remit-to instructions. Please confirm the remit entity and whether you need our W-9 or EU VAT form.

If it helps, I can loop in Priyom in Finance and Lauren (your technical AM) to expedite a formal quote. Also happy to propose an introductory concession for an initial short-term commitment to get you onboarded. What cadence/timing works for your team for a signed PO?

Best,
Jonas Weber
